title: Borussia Dortmund bows to fan pressure and end Rheinmetall deal
summary: Borussia Dortmund has reluctantly ended its association with a major sponsor after long-term fan protests. They are not the first Bundesliga club to u-turn, as commercial interests clash with politics and fan culture.

title: 'Coalition of the Willing' meets in Berlin: Europe remains committed to Ukraine
summary: The "Coalition of the Willing" supporting Ukraine is gathering in Berlin. One of the key issues under discussion is whether Europe will be able to play a role in future negotiations over the country's future.

title: How a green economy could help reverse climate change
summary: Green growth promises a future in which economies thrive without destroying the environment. But is this vision realistic?
